tui_runtime_app_confirm_pauses: Line added to the body of a TUI confirmation modal of the TUI. It lists the services an action pauses.
tui_runtime_app_event_crashed: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it exited with an error. {code} is the exit code.
tui_runtime_app_event_degraded: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it answers but is not ready and has no note.
tui_runtime_app_event_done: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: a one-shot finished well. i18n-distinct: a past participle after the service name, not the Done button of common_action_done (pt-BR: Concluir).
tui_runtime_app_event_failed: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it failed with no exit code.
tui_runtime_app_event_running: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it is up.
tui_runtime_app_event_stopped: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it stopped.
tui_runtime_app_event_unhealthy: Sidebar event of the TUI after the subject service: it stopped answering its health check and has no note.
tui_runtime_app_remote_owner_only: Toast of an attached TUI when an interactive action is triggered.
tui_runtime_app_remote_refused: Toast of an attached TUI when the runner refuses a request and gives no reason. {command} is the wire name of the request.
tui_runtime_app_restart_all_body: Body of the TUI confirmation modal for Restart all. {count} is the number of services.
tui_runtime_app_restart_all_title: Title of the TUI confirmation modal for Restart all.
tui_runtime_app_strip_starting: Status strip of the narrow TUI: the first service still starting, with no note.
tui_runtime_app_toast_action_failed: Toast of the TUI. A project action failed.
tui_runtime_app_toast_action_running: Toast of the TUI. A project action was triggered while it still runs.
tui_runtime_app_toast_ai_copied: Toast of the TUI. After copying the logs formatted as an AI prompt.
tui_runtime_app_toast_copied: Toast of the TUI. A link's text went to the clipboard.
tui_runtime_app_toast_critical: Toast of the TUI. A critical alert of the engine. {message} is the engine's own text.
tui_runtime_app_toast_deps_failed: Toast of the TUI. The pre_command failed; services start anyway.
tui_runtime_app_toast_deps_installed: Toast of the TUI. The pre_command finished.
tui_runtime_app_toast_detach_hint: Toast of the owning TUI when the detach key is pressed.
tui_runtime_app_toast_device_gone: Toast of the TUI. A phone or simulator of a mobile session went away. A warning sign is shown before it.
tui_runtime_app_toast_errors_copied: Toast of the TUI. After copying the errors. {count} is the number of log entries.
tui_runtime_app_toast_logs_cleared: Toast of the TUI. After Ctrl+L.
tui_runtime_app_toast_logs_copied: Toast of the TUI. After copying the last 3 minutes of logs.
tui_runtime_app_toast_mouse_off: Toast of the TUI. After the M key.
tui_runtime_app_toast_mouse_on: Toast of the TUI. After the M key.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_browser: Toast of the TUI. Opening a URL failed because no opener (open, xdg-open) exists.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_editor: Toast of the TUI. No editor is configured for a file link, so the location went to the clipboard.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_error_lines: Toast of the TUI. The jump to next or previous error found none.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_errors: Toast of the TUI. Copy errors found nothing to copy.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_links: Toast of the TUI. The link key found no link in the visible log lines.
tui_runtime_app_toast_no_problem_lines: Toast of the TUI. The jump to next or previous warning found none.
tui_runtime_app_toast_nothing_to_restart: Toast of the TUI. Restart all with no service to restart.
tui_runtime_app_toast_opening: Toast of the TUI. A service is opening in the browser.
tui_runtime_app_toast_opening_path: Toast of the TUI. A file from a log link is opening in the editor.
tui_runtime_app_toast_path_missing: Toast of the TUI. A path in a log line does not exist, so its text went to the clipboard.
tui_runtime_app_toast_restarted_n: Toast of the TUI. After Restart all finished. {count} is the number of services.
tui_runtime_app_toast_restarting: Toast of the TUI. A service is being restarted.
tui_runtime_app_toast_restarting_n: Toast of the TUI. Right after the person confirmed Restart all. {count} is the number of services.
tui_runtime_app_toast_running: Toast of the TUI. A project action started.
tui_runtime_app_toast_select_link: Toast of the TUI. Open or copy was pressed with no link selected. {key} is the Tab key name.
tui_runtime_app_toast_session_ended: Toast of the TUI. A session tab closed. A stop sign is shown before it.
tui_runtime_app_toast_starting: Toast of the TUI. A service is being started from the menu.
tui_runtime_app_toast_stopped: Toast of the TUI. A service stopped.
tui_runtime_app_toast_stopping: Toast of the TUI. A service is being stopped.
tui_runtime_app_toast_tunnel_close: Toast of the TUI. After the tunnel key: quitting closes the tunnel.
tui_runtime_app_toast_tunnel_runner: Toast of the TUI. The tunnel key in a TUI attached to a runner.
tui_runtime_app_toast_tunnel_stay: Toast of the TUI. After the tunnel key: quitting leaves the tunnel open.
tui_runtime_app_toast_update_on_exit: Toast of the TUI. The person accepted the update on exit.
tui_runtime_app_toast_wrap_off: Toast of the TUI. After the W key.
tui_runtime_app_toast_wrap_on: Toast of the TUI. After the W key.
tui_runtime_app_update_offer: Body of the TUI modal offering an update on exit. {version} is the new version.
tui_runtime_app_update_offer_runner: Same modal in a TUI attached to a runner. {command} is `atlas down && atlas dev --detach`.
tui_runtime_app_update_title: Title of the TUI modal offering an update on exit.
